material_class.structural_family: Tb4(μ3-OH)4 cubane with μ2-carboxylato-O,O' face bridges

synthesis.procedure: Pyridinoacetate (pybet) was prepared by a literature method. To an aqueous solution (3 cm3) of Tb(NO3)3 were added pybet (0.173 g, 1 mmol) and an ethanolic solution (2 cm3) of o-phenanthroline (0.2 g, 1 mmol), followed by an aqueous solution of NaClO4 (3 mmol). The mixture was stirred at 60 °C for 20 min and then allowed to evaporate slowly in air. After about a week, colorless crystals of complex 1 were obtained.

properties.summary: DC and AC magnetochemistry of polycrystalline 1 shows a nearly temperature-independent μeff/molecule of 18.83 μB at 319.9 K to 18.61 μB at 50.0 K in 10.0 kG, close to the spin-orbit-only Tb4 value of 19.4 μB, then a field-dependent drop at low T (to 11.2 μB at 2.01 K in 10.0 kG; to 13.7 μB at 1.79 K in zero DC / 1.0 G AC). No out-of-phase AC signal was observed. A single-exchange fit of the zero-field data gave g = 1.41 and Q = −0.015 cm−1 (TIP fixed at 600×10−6 cgsu). The authors conclude either very weak Tb···Tb antiferromagnetic exchange (J/Q = −0.015 cm−1) or, more likely, crystal-field splitting of the 7F6 Tb(III) ground state.
